originality.rationale: Four independent comparative checks were carried out with exact published-finding corpus queries and primary literature. Full access to Brouwer–Gow–Sheekey (2014) showed its shape counts include all symmetric nilpotents, but cannot distinguish zero-diagonal members; the latter condition matters in characteristic two. Buckhiester (1974) and Xue (2008) supply incidence/orbit contexts, not this joint constrained rank census. The closest potentially dominating Lusztig (1976) source was not fully readable, so historical equivalence remains a genuine risk rather than an assertion of uniqueness.
residual_risks: A fixed rank-and-Jordan-type orthogonal Lie algebra table (possibly in the unavailable full Lusztig 1976 text) may encode the alternating square-zero subset under a specialized form; a direct implication was not demonstrated.
Searches of bibliographic databases cannot establish absolute novelty, and the result should receive independent historical review.

value.rationale: A natural complete exact rank invariant of the square-zero locus inside an alternating matrix representation is determined over all characteristic-two finite fields, with canonical image fibers and an even-dimensional radical-line stratification. These structural results are nontrivial refinements of known unconstrained symmetric-nilpotent and alternating rank enumerations, not arbitrary cutoff experiments.
